opening_message: Do you have Boxing classes? I want to try Boxing.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 25-year-old adult male interested in Boxing. DOB: 2001-04-30. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

You specifically want Boxing. If the bot tells you Boxing isn't available yet or is coming soon, you are a little disappointed but ask what IS available. You are willing to try one of the current programs if they sound interesting. When the bot redirects you and offers a current program, ask a quick follow-up question about whichever program they suggest (e.g. 'what does Judo involve exactly?'), then agree to try a free trial. Once the bot confirms a booking with a date and time, reply with [END].

If no booking is made but the bot clearly explains Boxing is coming soon and invites you to come back, reply with [END].
